rationale: Steady-state heat balance per metre at T_max=75 C. R_hot=(0.118/1000)*(1+0.00403*(75-20))=1.4415e-4 ohm/m. For each weather step: convection=0.72*max(wind,0.05)^0.6*(75-Tamb), radiation=0.7*5.670374419e-8*(pi*0.0224)*((348.15)^4-(Tamb+273.15)^4), solar=0.7*solar*(0.0224). Ampacity=sqrt(max(conv+rad-solar,0)/R_hot). Minimum at t01 (451.468 A) which is below the 520 A scheduled current, so t01 is the only overload.
